# maplephp/cache

> 标签: caching, filesystem, memcached, psr-16, psr-6

## 简介

MaplePHP Cache, user-friendly caching library with full PSR-6 and PSR-16 support.

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。

## 官网

- 官网：https://wazabii.se
- 源码仓库：https://github.com/MaplePHP/Cache.git
- Packagist 页面：https://packagist.org/packages/maplephp%2Fcache

## 获取地址

- Composer 安装：`composer require maplephp/cache`
- Packagist 仓库：https://repo.packagist.org/p2/maplephp/cache.json
- 许可证：Apache-2.0
- PHP 要求：>=8.2
